why: Made each AI-assisted response identify its model and reasoning effort when available. This makes model routing observable without exposing private operating details.
demonstrates: Turns invisible AI configuration into a verifiable, human-readable control. Uses an explicit unknown state instead of false precision.

why: Framed the operating layer as the evolving system behind the products rather than presenting the portfolio infrastructure as a product by itself.
demonstrates: Explains system ownership and product boundaries clearly as the work evolves.

why: Chose a bounded canary before expanding scheduled finding intake into a broader reporting architecture.
demonstrates: Uses staged validation to control uncertainty before scaling automation.

why: Separated shared skill source from runtime-specific adaptations so reusable workflows can survive upgrades.
demonstrates: Designs reusable infrastructure with explicit boundaries and failure controls.

why: Separated product-code freshness from later documentation and operations work so the public proof describes what actually changed.
demonstrates: Maintains an evidence boundary between shipped product work and follow-up work.

why: Anchored recruiter-facing claims to committed source state and excluded uncommitted local work.
demonstrates: Chooses verifiable evidence over a stronger but unsupported progress story.

why: Preserved distinct roles for orientation, durable status, and direct freshness verification in the product handoff.
demonstrates: Designs information hierarchies that help people find the right level of truth.

why: Kept repo-owned durable documents with the project they govern while shared agent documentation remains cross-runtime.
demonstrates: Uses clear ownership boundaries to keep durable knowledge maintainable.

why: Placed the decision, recommended action, response options, and concise evidence near the top of decision-heavy reports.
demonstrates: Makes complex review outputs easier for people to understand and act on.

why: Turned workflow improvements into supporting proof while keeping concrete product work as the main recruiter signal.
demonstrates: Packages operating-layer improvements without letting infrastructure replace product evidence.

why: Kept concrete products ahead of the operating layer in the recruiter-facing proof structure.
demonstrates: Prioritizes the clearest audience signal while preserving the enabling system.

why: Presented PKM as supporting evidence until sustained adoption and daily-use value are validated.
demonstrates: Uses conservative evidence boundaries instead of overstating product maturity.

why: Used household budgeting to demonstrate shared roles, imports, review flows, forecasts, and privacy-sensitive domain modeling.
demonstrates: Frames a multi-user domain with explicit roles, constraints, and review needs.

title: Use a reviewed career workflow instead of an autonomous applier
why: Started with a reviewed workflow connecting discovery, fit analysis, application support, privacy, and feedback instead of unreviewed application sending.
demonstrates: Uses user control and explicit risk boundaries to shape an AI-assisted product flow.

title: Treat telemetry and outcome learning as a product layer
why: Included telemetry and outcome learning as a medium-priority capability, while keeping measurement ahead of outcome claims.
demonstrates: Designs feedback loops that improve the product without inventing unmeasured results.

title: Test a job-search sprint or focused monthly plan first
why: Kept a time-boxed job-search sprint and a lightweight monthly plan as the first pricing hypotheses while willingness to pay remains unvalidated.
demonstrates: Frames pricing around user value and clearly separates hypotheses from market evidence.

title: Defer household-budget pricing until trust and daily value are proven
why: Deferred pricing until workflow safety, import quality, privacy, and repeated household value are stronger.
demonstrates: Uses trust and evidence thresholds before making commercial product decisions.

title: Defer PKM pricing until daily-use value is validated
why: Deferred pricing until one end-to-end daily-use path demonstrates repeated value across ingestion, search, learning, and capture.
demonstrates: Protects commercial credibility by testing repeated value before selecting a pricing model.
